## Context / Problem

`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_main_truthful_tally.py:87-106` only asserts that stdout lacks `converged`, although successful applied work must print an applied/total tally. Empty output can currently pass.

## Approach

Strengthen the existing liveness assertion to require the exact nonempty applied/total success line and add an empty-output negative control. This changes only the oracle, not reconcile behavior.

## Scope

- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_main_truthful_tally.py`

## Testing

Exercise successful nonzero apply output, empty stdout, and an existing failure/non-success control.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A successful applied reconciliation must emit the exact expected nonempty applied/total tally line. Verified: new assertion checks the exact tally string against real stdout.
- [x] Empty stdout fails the truthful-tally test. Verified: new negative-control test confirms empty stdout fails.
- [x] Existing non-success/failure output expectations remain covered. Verified: pre-existing failure-path test unchanged and still passing.
- [x] The focused tally suite passes. Verified: `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_main_truthful_tally.py` — 4 passed. Committed a7a9b6799c212a91e7218459122da03e68dc6a88, pushed as Gerrit change 2540 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).
